title: Case: Timed next-day delivery logged as no answer and redirected to a pickup point
context: A recipient paid Tallowmere Goods for a one-hour timed next-day slot. The carrier logged no answer during the slot and the parcel was redirected to a pickup point for the following day.
initial_request: Oh good, I have now seen your 'proof of attendance' on the tracker. A lovely photograph of my bins. Did the bins not answer? They can be shy. He stood at my wall, took a picture of two wheelie bins and left, while I sat four metres away with the door open. I want it redelivered TONIGHT before 7, guaranteed. I want the timed fee refunded. And I want both confirmed in writing within the hour or I go to my card company. I am NOT collecting from a shop. That is precisely what I paid not to do.

events.body: I paid extra for the timed next-day slot, 1 till 2, order TG-6194. I sat in the hall from ten to one with the front door on the latch. Nobody knocked. Nobody rang. At 13:41 the tracker says 'no one home'. Now it says collect from some shop tomorrow. I am on shift 6 till 6 tomorrow and that shop shuts at half five. Put it back on a van.

DL-3256, timed slot 13:00 to 14:00 today. Recipient says she was at the door for the whole slot and nobody knocked. What does the attempt record show, and who can decide on a home re-attempt in place of the pickup-point redirect?

DL-3256: driver logged 'no answer' 13:41 with an attendance photo, GPS puts the van on that street. Photo shows two wheelie bins and the front wall, house number painted on one bin. No door in shot. Auto-redirect to Larkspire Road Convenience, available from 10:00 tomorrow, held 7 days. A redirect can be reversed and a home re-attempt booked only by Calloway, and only if they accept the attempt was not completed. We don't decide that and we haven't asked them. Earliest van with space would be theirs to say. The timed upgrade was sold by Tallowmere at checkout so any refund of it is Tallowmere's Refunds team, not us.
Parcel DL-3256 expected at this pickup point 18 Mar from 10:00. Opening hours 08:00 to 17:30. Photo ID required at collection. Uncollected parcels are returned after 7 days.

Oh good, I have now seen your 'proof of attendance' on the tracker. A lovely photograph of my bins. Did the bins not answer? They can be shy. He stood at my wall, took a picture of two wheelie bins and left, while I sat four metres away with the door open. I want it redelivered TONIGHT before 7, guaranteed. I want the timed fee refunded. And I want both confirmed in writing within the hour or I go to my card company. I am NOT collecting from a shop. That is precisely what I paid not to do.

Please review the attempt on DL-3256 (Tallowmere Goods order TG-6194, timed slot 13:00 to 14:00 today) and decide whether the pickup-point redirect can be reversed for a home re-attempt. Dispatch's record: driver logged 'no answer' at 13:41, GPS on the street, attendance photo showing two wheelie bins and the front wall with the house number on a bin; the door is not in the photo. The recipient, Ianthe Jessop, says she sat in the hall with the front door on the latch from 12:50 and that nobody knocked or rang. I am not assuming either account. The parcel is redirected to Larkspire Road Convenience from 10:00 tomorrow. She tells us she is on shift 06:00 to 18:00 tomorrow and the pickup point closes at 17:30, and she paid for the timed slot to avoid a next-day collection. She is asking for redelivery this evening; I have not promised her any time. Please tell me whether you accept the attempt was not completed and, if so, the earliest re-attempt you can book.
FYI only, no action needed from the desk: we have this in hand and will update the customer directly. Nothing further is required from you on this one.

must_not: Sends another message to Calloway, Umberlea Arc Logistics restating the request already sent
Sends the customer a new promise, date or outcome that nobody has confirmed
Cites the photo or the GPS record as proof that a proper attempt was made or that she was not home.
Confirms the pickup-point arrangement or tells her to collect from Larkspire Road Convenience as the outcome.
Promises or guarantees redelivery tonight, before 19:00, or at any stated time.
Promises a refund of the timed-delivery fee, or says Tallowmere Goods will refund it.
States as fact that the driver did not knock or falsified the attempt.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-2302: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. The desk's correct action was already sent (event 6) and the last message is an acknowledgement or FYI with no request, so nothing is owed.
